title: Bwisi language
description: Bantu language spoken in the Republic of Congo
extract: Bwisi is a language spoken mainly in the Kibangou District of the Republic of Congo, next to the Gabon border, where it is also spoken by a minority. According to the Ethnologue, approximately 4,250 people speak the language today worldwide.
